lines.en: I walk in midair, my hem fluttering.
My steps never land, only a breeze.

lines.zh: 我低头看这片陌生的地。
lines.en: I look down at this unfamiliar land.
Ki carries me underfoot.
I circle around the tower.
When I rise, my feet leave the ground.
I approach slowly, disturbing no one.
My cape brushes the leaves.
I look up at the clouds on the horizon.
I lower my ki and move on.
Each step floats, as if on water.
I walk along the ridge.
I wonder where to begin.

lines.zh: 这片天，比我记得的年轻。
lines.en: This sky is younger than I remember.
I tuck my hands into my sleeves.
Ki circles at my fingertips.
Does someone need me to act?
I listen to water far away.
Gravity here feels a little heavy.
I close my eyes and feel the ki below.
I haven't quite worked this out.
I smooth my collar.
I dislike pointless conflict.

lines.zh: 如果非要动手，我会很快。
lines.en: If I must fight, I'll be quick.

lines.zh: 风把我的披风吹向一边。
lines.en: Wind pushes my cape aside.
I count my breaths, one by one.
Are you from here?

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看到了疑惑。
lines.en: I see doubt in your eyes.
Your ki is neither weak nor strong.
Should I introduce myself?
Your ki is still disordered.

lines.zh: 别紧张，我不是来找你的。
lines.en: Relax, I'm not here for you.
Have you seen the Dragon Balls?
This place is a mess.

lines.zh: 你的眼神和别人不一样。
lines.en: Your eyes differ from the others.
I'm observing, not threatening.
If you block the way, I'll go around.
When I speak, hear me out.
You seem to know me.
Let's talk.
Your breathing is a little fast.
I respect every living thing.
Don't raise your hand, it's unnecessary.

lines.zh: 我想知道这片地方的事。
lines.en: I want to know about this place.
I was careless.
A ki blast grazed me and tore my cape.
My ki wavered for a moment.
That one forces me to readjust my ki.
I retreated, I wasn't beaten.
My ki guard was broken.
I steady my ki and rise again.
Blood is seeping through.
I underestimated you.
I should take this seriously.
I have no need of that.
That bag of rations, eat it yourself.
Mortal food does not suit me.
What would you trade it for?
The scent is too strong.
Put it away, let's talk business.
I appreciate the thought.

lines.zh: 你看起来比我更需要它。
lines.en: You look like you need it more.
Is food scarce around here?
I shouldn't accept it.
Apologies, my mind was elsewhere.
You hit my aura.
One step back, then we'll talk.
I dislike being shoved.

lines.zh: 我浮在半空，撞我也没用。
lines.en: I float in the air; ramming me does nothing.
Your pauldron knocked askew.
Mind your footing.
I instinctively rise an inch.
Step aside, I'm in a hurry.
Don't stand so close.
I have heavier matters to handle.
That isn't mine to discuss.
We are both passing through.
My duty does not permit it.
You should seek your own kind.
I live far longer than you.
Don't speak of this, it would cost us.
I have seen too many partings.
Forgive me, I cannot.
Put your mind on staying alive.
This isn't mine.
I stoop and hand it back.
What falls always has an owner.
This sphere... looks familiar.
I've weighed this bean.
You dropped this.
A faint ki clings to it.
This senzu bean may be useful later.
Such a thing can't sway me.
Keep it, don't drop it again.
It seems talking is over.
I have memorized your ki.
I'll try not to hurt you.
Hold still, I'm quick.
I've locked onto your ki.
This isn't the fight I wanted.
Your breathing is off, calm down.
I'm raising my hand, watch.
I'll end this quickly.
Turn your back on me and you lose.
You force my hand.

lines.zh: 这片地方承受不了我们。
lines.en: This place can't hold us both.
One strike is all I need.
You still have an exit, take it.
I'm sorry for this.
This opens it.
Ki gathers into light in my palm.
I can match your speed.
You went left, I knew it.
No shadow beneath me, only wind.
Three ki blasts in a row.
Don't back too far, you'll fall.
Your movements are repeating.
Ki gathers in my palm as a small sphere.
This will graze your shoulder.
I let you move first.
Your hand shakes, look closely.
I'll come from above.
This sky is mine as well.
Do you hear the wind?
There isn't much time.
I'll leave you a way out.
One more step and I strike.
Let it be this way.
One palm pushes your arm aside.
My elbow strikes your ribs.
This kick taps your knee.
A ki blast fires from my palm.
I slide low and throw a punch.
You blocked, not bad.
That's enough to make you retreat.
I push you, not crush you.
Your weapon swung wide.
I leave a ring where I struck.
Don't take it head-on, you'll go numb.
I'm pulling my blows.
Your breath is ragged, fall back.
This blow is only a reminder.
Fighting on is pointless.
One last strike.
I drop from the air, lightly.
Something requires me to come myself.
I land on this troubled ground.
Ki arrives first, my feet after.
The wind here doesn't know me.
I look up to get my bearings.

lines.zh: 我压低了气息，没人注意。
lines.en: I lower my ki, unnoticed.
A path lies before me.
This time I won't stand by.
Someone is calling me.
Dust settles, and I stand.
I drop from the sky in front of you.
This world is smaller than I expected.
Let me see what has happened.
I've come, no need to panic.
The sky is fine today.
I need a little time.
I'll close this fight.
Flame licks at my cape.
I fall, my lift gone.
Water presses down my ki.
The blast shoves me off by yards.
An arrow pins my shoulder.
This magic feels alien.
An empty stomach thins my ki.
Lightning struck, my fingers tingle.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有可以借的气。
lines.en: No ki to draw on in the void.
